chunks: Whoever passes between the two narrow paths of Minā without arrogance, Allah will forgive his sins.

key_terms.مَأْزِمَيْ: the two narrow mountain paths or passes
key_terms.مِنًى: Minā, the sacred location associated with hajj rites

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for passing between the narrow paths of Minā without arrogance?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a merit connected to one of the rites and locations of hajj in Minā. It teaches that humility during the pilgrimage is a means for Allah’s forgiveness of sins.
